title: Create a React app wired to the workspace conventions
description: Vite + React Router + Tailwind v4 via the shared ui styles, Hebrew RTL shell, GitHub Pages base path.

name.description: App name in kebab-case. Creates apps/<name>.

scope.description: dev = internal helper app (may import anything); product = shipped to users (cannot import scope:dev).

port.description: Dev server port. Defaults to the next free port after the existing apps.
